title: RAG knowledge assistant over internal Confluence and PDFs
description:
We need a retrieval-augmented assistant that answers employee questions from our Confluence space (about 4,000 pages) and a folder of policy PDFs. Users are on Microsoft Teams. Data must stay in Azure (we have Azure OpenAI access). Access control matters: people must only get answers from pages they can see.

Rate not decided yet; tell us your rate.
